lcc_original: 永恆主對該隱說：『旣然如此，凡殺該隱的就須遭報七倍。』永恆主便給該隱立個記號，免得遇見他的人擊殺他。
notes: 旣然如此 renders the implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH03651>} (לָכֵן = 'therefore') explicitly in LCC — dropped braces per Rule 3 and attached both tags to the phrase
LCC 遇見他的人 inverts UNV 人遇見他 word order; H4672+TH8802 attached to 遇見 (the verb) and WAH03605 to 人 (the nominal head)
LCC 永恆主 systematically replaces UNV 耶和華 for H3068 — no alignment ambiguity, just a known rendering difference
LCC omits 一 before 個記號 (UNV: 一個記號), so H226 attaches to 個記號 alone
First occurrence: LCC 對該隱 explicitly names Cain where UNV has pronoun 他 — WAH09001 attaches to 該隱 as the Hebrew prefix-bearing object
